visualCharacteristics.purpose: row of 2-3 short, divider-separated columns, each a quick path (icon + heading, optional text, arrow link) or a key term (label, value, fine print)

contentPattern.structure: one row, one cell per column; each cell holds an optional icon, a heading (or label), optional body text and an optional single-link paragraph as the CTA

usage: Use for a horizontal set of quick paths (Buy / Refinance / Use equity) or card key terms (Annual fee, APR, Balance transfer fee). Add in-box-with-text when the columns sit in a boxed panel with body copy, key-terms for label/value/fine-print stacks, light for light text on a dark section.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any 2-4 column, text-only row separated by vertical dividers. Use cards for image-led tiles and plain columns for media + text layouts.
